Build the outbound motion with the founder and start conversations with suppliers’ finance leaders.

Explore all roles ↗

About Mozart

Mozart does the work companies have with other organizations: the requests, claims, submissions and payments that go out, and the answers that must come back.

The role

You'll start conversations with the finance leaders at food, beverage and foodservice suppliers who are losing money to deductions. You'll build the outbound motion from scratch with the founder, and own the top of our funnel.

What you’ll own

  • Finding and qualifying suppliers: building target lists by category, retailer mix and size
  • Outbound across email, LinkedIn and phone, with messaging grounded in each prospect’s real deduction pain
  • Booking qualified meetings and handing them off with clear notes
  • Working trade shows and industry events, both in person and on the follow-up
  • Tracking what works in the CRM and feeding objections back into the product and pitch

About you

  • 1+ years in B2B sales development, or a track record of outbound in a startup or student venture
  • Persistent, curious, and comfortable with rejection
  • Write short, specific outreach and learn a technical domain quickly
  • Fluent with modern outbound tools (HubSpot or similar, Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn)

Nice to have

Selling to CFOs or controllers; CPG, food/bev or distribution experience; finance or accounting coursework.

Growth path

Account Executive, customer success, or leading the SDR team as it grows.

Details

Full-time, NYC, with some travel to industry events.
